# Vendored certificate checker

The needed97-module LeanCert source closure is copied from
alerad/leancert@6320a15be41a27701fabb3b49e73cc187f76f37d. Its Apache2.0license
and complete upstream/vendored source-hash inventory are here. One missing copyright header is added; all code bodies remain unchanged. All numeric certificates are
checked by the kernel with only the standard three axioms. No external
LeanCert dependency is fetched. This follows the vendoring option in
https://github.com/teorth/IEANTN/issues/164.
